functionalSourceDetermination.conclusion: No arbitrary choice was made. Evidence (migration docstrings, code guard-checks labeling "canonical" vs "legacy", frontend page wiring, report registry) shows a real, in-progress, intentional migration: legacy transactions+old rules-based categories -> new financial_transactions+financial_categories(tree)+supporting normalized tables, with the category side complete and functional and the transaction ledger side still mid-migration (schema ready, write path not yet cut over). [conclusion preserved verbatim as historical evidence — see poDecisionCorrection: this migration direction was subsequently REJECTED by the Product Owner]
functionalSourceDetermination.poDecisionCorrection: CANONICAL CORRECTION (Product Owner decision REMOVE_SECOND_ACCOUNTING_LAYER, resolves PO-VERIFY-027 — see docs/backend-v2/review/01-full-project-exhaustive-verification.md §XV.6 and docs/backend-v2/gap-resolution/00-canonical-gap-register.md): the 'in-progress migration' read above is superseded. financial_transactions, financial_accounts, cost_centers, counterparties, transaction_allocations, performance_metric_entries, budgets and budget_revisions are REJECTED_ARCHITECTURE — none will be used by the v2 architecture, as target, future path, or valid alternative. transactions is, and remains, the single canonical financial ledger; there will be no second ledger.
